# Site GitHub config (moved)

GitHub only runs workflows and Dependabot config from the **repository root** `.github/` directory.

| Former path (inert here) | Authoritative location |
|--------------------------|------------------------|
| `workflows/ci.yml` | [`.github/workflows/site-ci.yml`](../../../.github/workflows/site-ci.yml) |
| `dependabot.yml` | [`.github/dependabot.yml`](../../../.github/dependabot.yml) |

See [`docs/migrations/monorepo-phase-2/`](../../../docs/migrations/monorepo-phase-2/) for Phase 2 notes.
